payload.description_html:
July 22, 2011 - Enid, Mississippi

This white-colored channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) was raised at a private hatchery and subsequently brought to North Mississippi Fish Hatchery for the public to enjoy.

Credit: Rebecca M. Krogman, USFWS
